svg.title: PPO turns final reward into policy updates
svg.desc: In RLHF, the policy samples a response, a reward model scores it at the end, and a KL term regularizes against the reference policy. A value head estimates advantages for token actions; PPO clipping limits policy updates while reusing samples.

g.text: PPO turns final reward into policy updates
The reward is sparse; a value head estimates credit and clipping limits policy drift.
PPO-RLHF · FOUR MODELS, ONE TRAINING LOOP
Reward arrives at EOS; the value head estimates per-token credit.
Four models: policy · reference · reward · value.
